flavor.zianmanager.flame_spear.line1: Forged where the sun first touched stone.
flavor.zianmanager.flame_spear.line2: Its ember remembers an age without winter.
flavor.zianmanager.void_staff.line1: A shard of silence between the stars.
flavor.zianmanager.void_staff.line2: A forgotten voice sleeps within its crystal.
flavor.zianmanager.gladiator_sword.line1: Its steel bears the names of the undefeated.
flavor.zianmanager.gladiator_sword.line2: Glory is won; it is never bestowed.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_ancientblade.li: Guarded beneath the roots of a lost kingdom.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_dragonrend.line: Tempered beneath the shadow of ancient wings.
The gold upon its edge has known no king.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_withersym.line1: Born among the ashes of a broken crown.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_withersym.line2: Its shadow seeks one final dawn.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_omen.line1: A dark star marked its birth.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_omen.line2: Fate falls silent before its crystal point.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_tide.line1: A relic of a throne lost beneath the sea.
flavor.zianmanager.blue_hammer.line1: Carved in the ice of an eternal mountain.
flavor.zianmanager.blue_hammer.line2: Its echo travels the chambers of the world.
flavor.zianmanager.green_hammer.line2: The woodland spirit endures beneath its metal.
flavor.zianmanager.grey_hammer.line1: The final work of the stone smiths.
flavor.zianmanager.grey_hammer.line2: A fortress once rested upon its steel.
flavor.zianmanager.red_hammer.line1: Born in a forge that never grew cold.
flavor.zianmanager.red_hammer.line2: The mountain remembers the mark of its fire.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_amaxe.line1: Violet crystals crown its ancient steel.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_amaxe.line2: It witnessed the fall of a golden age.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_ampick.line1: A song lies hidden beneath every stone.
flavor.zianmanager.altar_ampick.line2: Its crystal hears the secrets of the earth.
flavor.zianmanager.warrior_reskin.line1: Forjada para el último rey del alba.
flavor.zianmanager.warrior_reskin.line2: Su filo aún exige una promesa de valor.
flavor.zianmanager.warrior_reskin.line3: Que tu acero recuerde quién eres.
flavor.zianmanager.necromancer_reskin.li: Su sombra protege al que desafía el final.
Ninguna noche devora a su portador.
flavor.zianmanager.ninja_reskin.line1: Guardó mil secretos bajo un cielo azul.
flavor.zianmanager.ninja_reskin.line2: Solo la luna conoce sus antiguos nombres.
flavor.zianmanager.ninja_reskin.line3: Un destello basta para escribir el destino.
flavor.zianmanager.chainsaw.line1: Nacida en las forjas de una guerra olvidada.
flavor.zianmanager.chainsaw.line2: Sus dientes cantan el ocaso de los reinos.
flavor.zianmanager.chainsaw.line3: La voluntad del hierro nunca se quiebra.
flavor.zianmanager.flame_spear.line3: An ancient oath awakens in your hands.
flavor.zianmanager.void_staff.line3: An ancient oath awakens in your hands.
